sources.title: Civil Service Leadership Statement
sources.author: UK Civil Service; updated 25 August 2016
sources.sections: Statement characteristics: modeled conduct, clear direction, candid communication, objectives and authority
sources.supported_use: Relate expectations to visible leadership conduct and a usable direction.
sources.limits: Historical statement of institutional expectations, not a validated leadership scale. Linked videos, wallet cards, training and self-assessments were not inspected.

sources.title: OECD Public Integrity Handbook: Leadership
sources.author: OECD; 20 May 2020
sources.sections: Chapter 6 abstract, 6.1 and opening 6.2: support, selection, incentives and accountability for integrity leadership
sources.supported_use: Examine organizational support and systems around use of authority.
sources.limits: Selected chapter passages only; no full handbook, underlying studies, country framework or validated causal effect. Administrative public-sector context is not a universal employment or governance rule.

sources.title: Government Functional Standard GovS 002: Project delivery (HTML)
sources.author: Government Project Delivery; version 2.1
sources.sections: 4.1 governance limits and autonomy, 4.3 decisions, 4.4.1 role definition, 7.12 stakeholder engagement and 7.13 communications
sources.supported_use: Use explicit decision rights, timely options, relevant expertise and updated stakeholder understanding.
sources.limits: Selected sections only, not the full standard, Teal Book, investment rules or linked analyses. The original low-stakes exercises do not establish government-standard conformance or optimal decisions.

sources.title: Mentoring and Coaching
sources.author: U.S. Office of Personnel Management
sources.sections: Opening distinction between immediate skill-focused coaching and broader developmental mentoring
sources.supported_use: Distinguish the purpose of a skill practice from a longer developmental relationship.
sources.limits: Brief agency framing only; general benefits are not adopted as measured outcomes or validation of the exercise. No coach certification, career guarantee or actual learner evidence.

sources.title: Developing Performance Standards
sources.author: U.S. Office of Personnel Management
sources.sections: Definition, general measures and opening specific measures: clear realistic standards and verifiable criteria
sources.supported_use: Make the expected work and the basis of review explicit.
sources.limits: Conceptual use only. Federal appraisal levels and personnel rules are not imported as universal employment requirements. No legal, HR or disciplinary ruling.

sources.title: OECD Public Integrity Handbook: Openness
sources.author: OECD; 20 May 2020
sources.sections: 9.1, opening 9.2 and selected 9.2.2–9.2.3 passages on engagement and responsive management
sources.supported_use: Connect an invitation to raise concerns with a credible response and usable route.
sources.limits: Selected passages only. Underlying studies, national legal reporting protections and full whistleblower-system sections are not adopted. No confidentiality guarantee or proof of psychological safety.

sources.title: CERC: Introduction
sources.author: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.sections: Introduction and six principles, PDF pages 2–3 (zero-based pages 1–2)
sources.supported_use: Use timely accurate communication, acknowledge people, and state useful action under uncertainty.
sources.limits: Text of the introductory principles only, not the full CERC manual, training, emergency plan or incident-command qualification. No live drill, technical safety instruction or effectiveness claim.

sources.title: Knowledge Management
sources.author: NASA APPEL Knowledge Services
sources.sections: Overview of critical knowledge, context, lessons and continuity; identification of transition resources
sources.supported_use: Preserve understandable critical knowledge for successors.
sources.limits: Overview only; linked policy, continuity reports and templates were not inspected. No NASA conformance, real appointment, access transfer or institution-wide resilience finding.

sources.title: Identifying and managing conflicts of interest in a charity
sources.author: Charity Commission for England and Wales; updated 22 April 2026
sources.sections: Definition, loyalty conflicts, governing-document check and steps 1–5 including recording disposition
sources.supported_use: Distinguish identifying a conflict from actually managing and recording it.
sources.limits: Jurisdiction is England and Wales and subject is charity trustees. Charity-specific duties, quorum, benefits and authorization rules are not generalized to the fictional group. Linked law and legal-note analysis were not inspected; no personal legal ruling.
